title: Fibonacci: Recursive Calculation
description: A recursive fib function that returns n for base cases and fib(n-1) + fib(n-2) for larger n. Printing fib(10) demonstrates the result.

steps.description: The fib function takes n and returns n directly when n is 0 or 1.
For n greater than 1, fib returns the sum of fib(n-1) and fib(n-2).
The print statement calls fib(10) to compute the 10th Fibonacci number.
